event_name: Document 48 Date 18 April 2021 Time 15:42 2021 EMILIA ROMAGNA GRAND PRIX 15 - 18 April 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 11 overtook two cars during a safety car period.
incident_time: Penalty. (2 penalty points imposed, total of 4 points in the 12-month period)
offence: Breach of Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed multiple angles of video evidence. Perez skidded off the track in the wet conditions during the safety car period. Upon rejoining the track, he then passed the two cars that had proceeded on the track past the point of his incident, which he was not entitled to do under Art 39.8
rules_referenced: Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 11 Overtaking During A Safety Car Period
